buy_title: The exact Levoit Core 300-P to order, and the filter that keeps it honest
buy_total: Two paid links, one purifier and one refill. The buttons show today's price; as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, and it never changes what you pay. Other stores' prices quoted in the guide were listed in September 2026 and move with sales.

cards.name: Levoit Core 300-P Air Purifier
cards.badge: Product of the day · the value pick in air purifiers
cards.price: About $85–$100 at major retailers at the time of writing (Home Depot $89.98, Levoit.com $89.99, Walmart $99.00, as listed in September 2026; $99.99 list)
cards.buy_if: you want one bedroom, nursery or home office (about 220 sq ft) cleaned quietly all night for the price of a month of allergy pills.
cards.skip_if: you want to clean an open-plan floor, will not budget for a filter every 6–8 months, or want a sensor, auto mode and an app (that is the Core 300S-P, about $25–45 more).
cards.owners: Target's listing showed a 4.61 out of 5 owner average (September 27, 2026); across retailer reviews, forums and long-term write-ups, owners praise the quiet sleep mode and how it clears smells, and fault the filter bill and the reset light that stays on.

buy.pick: Core 300-P in white (the black one does the same job); one Original 3-in-1 filter is already inside the base
buy.check: The buy box says Sold by Amazon.com or Levoit; the title reads Core300-P; skip marketplace offers at or above the $99.99 list
buy.label: See today's price

cards.name: Levoit Core 300-RF Replacement Filter (genuine Original 3-in-1)
cards.price: About $20–$30 for a genuine filter at the time of writing (Levoit.com lists it at $29.99, per levoitreview.com's 2026 filter guide); less in sale weeks
cards.buy_if: you keep the purifier: one or two a year, on Subscribe & Save so the delivery lands about when the light comes on.
cards.skip_if: you are tempted by a no-name 'compatible' filter at half price that states no filter class; Levoit warns non-genuine filters may mean lower air quality and a damaged motor.
cards.owners: the most common support complaint is the reset light staying on after a change; the light is a timer, and a three-second hold on the Check Filter button clears it (HouseFresh's problem list; the manual).

buy.pick: Genuine Core 300-RF Original 3-in-1 (newer boxes say Core 300-P-RF); Pet Allergy, Toxin Absorber and Smoke Remover versions fit the same slot
buy.check: Sold by Amazon.com or Levoit; Levoit's QR/hologram seal on the box; the 2-pack is usually the better price per filter
buy.label: See filter price
